bias.en: Downtrend · broke $818, below the Jul 17 low
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 跌破 $818，失守 7月17日低点

read.en: Micron fell 7.0% on Nov 4 to $795.23, trading between $791.03 and $853.34 on heavy volume, down 19.1% in five sessions. It is below the falling 5-day ($860.6), 10-day ($885.3), 30-day ($967.2) and 100-day ($967.1) averages and above the rising 200-day ($753.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($983.63), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: 美光 11月4日下跌 7.0%，收于 $795.23，盘中区间 $791.03–853.34，成交量放大，五个交易日累计下跌 19.1%。股价位于下行的 5 日（$860.6）、10 日（$885.3）、30 日（$967.2）和 100 日均线（$967.1）下方，并高于上行的 200 日均线（$753.9）。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$983.63），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The close broke the $845–849, $829.2 and $818.7 supports and the $804 Jul 17 low. Resistance is now $804–818.7, then $845.3–853.3 (Nov 3 and Oct 22 lows, Nov 4 high) and $860.6–861.6 (5-day, Oct 30 low). Support is $791 (Nov 4 low), then $753.9 (200-day) and $737.9 (Jul 29 low). A close above $818.7 would target $845–853; below $791, $754.

r.en: Nov 3 low $845.27; Oct 22 low $849.25; Nov 4 high $853.34
